title: Duty Periods — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
A working pattern made of duties, and the holiday calendar that goes with it. Employees get a duty period directly (employee duty periods) or through their roster group.

It works one of two ways. Without a start point on the employee's assignment, each weekday takes the duty set for it here — Sunday's duty every Sunday. With a start point, the pattern is the rotation of weeks set in the duty period's details, and the weekday duties here are not used.

Rotations and roster groups apply only when the time setting EnableRosterDuty is on; otherwise every employee gets the weekday duties of their own duty period.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: StartDate
fields.html: What it is. The first day this record applies.

fields.label: EndDate
fields.rules: Optional. Date value. Cannot be before the start date.
fields.html: What it is. The last day this record applies.

fields.label: HolidayCalendar
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Holiday Calendar master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The public holidays that apply to employees on this duty period.

Example. Kuwait Public Holidays

Why it matters. A day is a public holiday for the employee only if it is in this calendar.
